metadata.title: WaFine — WhatsApp gateway for teams
metadata.description: Connect a WhatsApp number, build paced auto-reply workflows, and expose it to your apps and agents through one REST API and MCP. By Zawia.

hero.h1: Your WhatsApp, working while you don't.
hero.subhead: Connect your number, build paced auto-reply workflows, and plug it into Claude and your own apps through one REST API and one MCP endpoint. Your session stays on our own server.

messages.text: Hi! Do you have a free slot tomorrow morning?
Yes — 10:00 and 11:30 are open. Which suits you?
Booked for tomorrow at 10:00. See you then.

hero.caption: Paced auto-reply conversation via WaFine.

howTo.heading: Three steps, no rewrites
howTo.intro: WaFine sits between WhatsApp and your tools. You keep the phone; we handle the session, the queue and the API surface.

steps.title: Connect your number
steps.body: Scan a QR code from WhatsApp Web once. The session is stored encrypted on our server in Casablanca — not on a laptop that sleeps.

steps.title: Write paced auto-replies
steps.body: Webhook in, workflow out. Every reply goes through a paced sender: a configurable gap between messages, a daily cap, and no retry storms.

steps.title: Call it from anywhere
steps.body: Mint a per-session API key and talk to the REST API, or add the MCP endpoint to Claude and use your number in plain language.

connector.heading: Add WaFine to Claude
connector.body: WaFine speaks OAuth, so Claude never sees your API key. Add the connector, sign in, review the consent screen and press Allow — we mint a key scoped to your own session, and you can revoke it at any time.

steps.connect: In Claude: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector.
steps.paste: Paste {connectorUrl} as the connector URL and press Connect.
steps.signIn: Sign in with your WaFine account, review what Claude may do, and press Allow.

connector.snippetHeading: Or from a terminal with Claude Code
connector.consentNote: The consent screen is explicit: Claude can read your chats, messages, contacts and groups, and send messages from your number — through your session only. Revoke the key and the access ends immediately.

features.heading: Built for a number that cannot afford to look like a bot

items.title: Paced sending
items.body: Every outbound message goes through one sender with a configurable gap and a per-day cap. No bursts, no retry storms, one path for AI-written text and manual replies alike.

items.title: Per-session API keys
items.body: Mint a key per WhatsApp session, see only its prefix, revoke it in one click. Bring one number or five; they never share credentials.

items.title: REST API and MCP
items.body: The same session answers JSON over REST and tool calls over MCP, so Claude, your scripts and your internal tools all speak to one endpoint.

items.title: QR linking in the browser
items.body: Link and re-link your number from the web app — QR code in, session alive. No docker commands, no shell on the server.

items.title: Data residency: Morocco and the EU
items.body: The gateway runs on our own VM in Casablanca; the database lives in Supabase’s Paris region. WhatsApp session data never leaves the server.

items.title: Open-core, on OpenWA
items.body: Built on the open-source OpenWA engine, in the open with the Ai4x Academy community. Read the docs, self-host it, or let us run it for you.

faq.heading: Questions people ask before signing up

items.a: Yes — any WhatsApp automation carries that risk, and no gateway can promise otherwise. WaFine reduces it: every send is paced with a configurable gap plus a per-day cap, there are no automatic retries, and one sender owns all outbound traffic. Only message people who contacted you first, and start slowly.
Access is invite-only. Join the waitlist and an admin invites the numbers we are ready to run. Sign-up then accepts that invited number only, in international format, and binds the account to it.

items.q: Where is my data, and what about the CNDP?
items.a: The WhatsApp session runs on our own VM in Casablanca and the application database is in Supabase’s Paris region, so your data stays in Morocco and the EU. Message content is stored encrypted, not as readable text, and we follow Moroccan law 09-08 expectations for personal data.
Any number that already has WhatsApp, personal or business — one number per session, unlimited sessions on your account. Landlines and numbers without WhatsApp cannot be linked.

Yes. WaFine is open-core on OpenWA: the repository ships the compose stack, the BFF and the web app, and the docs cover a full deployment. You bring a server, a domain and a database; we run the hosted version if you would rather not.

items.q: What happens if my session drops?
items.a: Nothing is deleted. The phone losing WhatsApp Web pauses the session: API and MCP calls return a clear “not ready” error instead of failing silently, and you re-link by scanning a new QR code from the web app.

naming.heading: Naming & Spelling
naming.darijaNote: Darija for 'where are you / what's up'
naming.rules: Always write WaFine with a capital W and capital F. In Arabic, write وافين. Never spell it as WAFINE, wafine, or Wa-Fine.
naming.unofficial: WaFine runs on unofficial clients (OpenWA) and is not affiliated with WhatsApp or Meta. Never use terms like 'WhatsApp Business API', 'Works with WhatsApp', or 'Powered by WhatsApp'.

logos.heading: Logo & Mark
logos.subhead: The WaFine mark is a rounded chat bubble containing the Arabic wordmark وافين.
logos.rules: The Arabic lettering is the HarfBuzz-shaped Noto Kufi Arabic Black outline used verbatim. Do not redraw, retype, or mirror the Arabic text. Never tint the logo with WhatsApp green (#25d366).

voice.heading: Voice & Tone
voice.principles: Direct, honest, and dry. We explain what the product does and what it cannot promise. We state that automation carries inherent platform risks and that WaFine's paced sending reduces risk, but never claim total immunity from bans.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: This is a starting point, not legal advice, and it will be reviewed before launch. It describes what WaFine does with your data today.

collect.heading: What we collect
collect.body: Account email, the WhatsApp number you link, your WhatsApp chats, messages, contacts and groups, and the API keys and sessions you create. Waitlist entries: the email, the optional number and note you submit, plus optional referral and UTM campaign tags from the landing-page URL; we use these tags in aggregate and do not use tracking cookies.

where.heading: Where it lives
where.body: The WhatsApp session and its local data stay on our own server in Casablanca. The application database is in Supabase’s Paris region. Message content is stored encrypted, not as readable text.

never.heading: What we never do
never.body: We do not sell your data, we do not train models on your messages, and we do not hand your session to another account. Media and backups are stored encrypted.

choices.heading: Your choices
choices.body: You can revoke API keys and disconnect a session from the web app at any time. To delete your account and its data, contact us at {contactEmail}.

terms.title: Terms
terms.lead: This is a starting point, not legal advice, and it will be reviewed before launch. It describes the rules of using WaFine today.

account.heading: Your account
account.body: WaFine is invite-only and bound to one WhatsApp number per session. Keep your API keys secret; anything sent with them is treated as yours.

use.heading: Acceptable use
use.body: Use WaFine only for numbers you own and people who expect to hear from you. Bulk unsolicited messaging, spam and anything that breaks WhatsApp’s terms are not allowed and will end your access.

warranty.heading: No warranty
warranty.body: WaFine is provided as is, at an early stage, without warranty. WhatsApp may change or restrict the linked-device behaviour it relies on, and your number remains subject to WhatsApp’s own rules.

changes.heading: Changes
changes.body: We may update these terms as the product changes. Material changes will be announced in the app before they take effect.
